sheet.title: P&IDS MEMBRANE BIOREACTOR BASIN
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: Horizontal bands: SCADA HMI / MBR PLC / MCC. Bubble position gives its location.
Diamond-in-square symbols marked DI, DO, AI are untagged PLC I/O points; they are not recorded as instruments, each is noted on the signal that passes through it.
Dashed outline = future: the third membrane unit 'SMU-' is labelled (FUTURE MEMBRANES) and its piping is drawn dashed.

A pair of parallel solid lines runs across all SMU risers just above the valve row (x 0.33 to 0.59) and turns up to a hexagon flag 'TP 03' with 'BO' and 'EQ' either side of two facing filled triangles. Read as a tie-point / scope-break marker (not a pipe); the risers are taken as continuous through it. Meaning of TP, BO and EQ is not explained on this sheet.
Line styles: process air is a thin dashed line; the diffuser return through XV-070181 is a heavy dashed line with no service label; permeate, acid wash, overflow and WAS are solid.
Sheet 12 of 25. CAD filename P-200 P&IDS.DWG. No revisions entered in revision table.
